verdict.rationale: Raygun is a SaaS monitoring platform with AI features powered by OpenAI and Azure OpenAI, so a training opt-out is a fair question. The evidence pack has no documented policy or setting that prevents customer data from being used to train AI models. Client-side sensitive-data filtering, the IP-storage toggle and the bring-your-own OpenAI key are adjacent privacy controls, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.
